faq.q: How is a titanium slit-valve oval bezel manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium slit-valve oval bezel is manufactured using Precision CNC turning; Electropolishing; Class 100 cleanroom cleaning; Helium leak testing. BOZE CNC Ti uses precision CNC equipment with strict process controls to ensure consistent quality and dimensional accuracy.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for titanium slit-valve oval bezel?
faq.a: Alternative materials include stainless steel (heavier, susceptible to corrosion) and aluminum (lower strength, shorter fatigue life). The alternative manufacturing method is Manual turning on conventional lathes (less consistent, higher rejection rate).
